claims.quote: Offset shift breaks UTC-midnight timestamps in UTC- zones
claims.notes: Obligation: the displayed day and the min/max bounds must equal the day the model holds in every timezone. Mechanism: the two lines added to _unlocal_date subtract getTimezoneOffset()*60000 from every input before the UTC day is read; render() applies it to value, min_date and max_date.
